description: This file sets up and runs a conversational bot pipeline using Pipecat framework, integrating speech recognition, text-to-speech, and language model services with custom transport and turn strategies.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema for defining functions callable by the LLM, including name, description, properties, and required fields.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema for defining tools and functions available to the LLM.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: Analyzes user turns to determine turn boundaries in conversations.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: Voice activity detection analyzer based on Silero models.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Frame used to trigger LLM execution in the pipeline.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Executes the pipeline, managing its lifecycle.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a pipeline execution task with parameters.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for a pipeline task.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Context object holding messages and tools for the LLM.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Aggregates context for user and assistant turns.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy to determine when to stop user turns.

classes.name: create_transport
classes.description: Function to create transport based on runner arguments.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch weather data via a callback.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot pipeline with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializing transport and starting the pipeline.
